name: ditrasoftware-template-mcp
description: DitraSoftware Template MCP - Base scaffolding for domain-specific MCP implementations

DITRASOFTWARE_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for DitraSoftware REST API (e.g. https://api.example.com)

DITRASOFTWARE_DEFAULT_API_KEY.description: Default API key for REST backend (used as fallback when no token provided)

DITRASOFTWARE_GATEWAY_ALLOW_DIRECT_CALLS.description: Allow direct remote tool calls via gateway_call_remote_tool

DITRASOFTWARE_GATEWAY_DIRECT_RESULT_STRA.description: Result handling strategy for direct remote calls: passthrough|normalized

DITRASOFTWARE_GATEWAY_REMOTES_JSON.description: Remote MCP backends JSON (array of {name, namespace, type, url, ...})

DITRASOFTWARE_GATEWAY_TOOL_ROUTE_OVERRID.description: Tool routing overrides JSON (object of tool_name -> 'local'|'remote')

DITRASOFTWARE_CACHE_TTL.description: Response cache time-to-live in seconds (FastMCP 4.0.0+, SEP-2549). Hint for clients to cache lists and resources.

DITRASOFTWARE_CACHE_SCOPE.description: Cache scope: public (shared across auth contexts) | private (per-auth context only). Requires CACHE_TTL.

DITRASOFTWARE_LIST_PAGE_SIZE.description: Maximum items per page for tool/resource lists. Enables pagination for large catalogs.

DITRASOFTWARE_MASK_ERROR_DETAILS.description: Mask internal error details in responses (true/false). Recommended for production.
